steps.speaker: Judge
steps.content: The champion has been decided! Let's congratulate the most dazzling player on the field, the deserving winner—Nike!
You remember this man. You've seen him hobbling to the theater on crutches before, getting into disputes over minor issues.
And now, he stands on the podium holding the trophy, full of vigor, his posture upright no different from the average person, a stark contrast to his initial shabbiness and irritability.

steps.speaker: Nike
steps.content: Thank you all for your support!

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Mr. Nike, first of all, congratulations on your victory! In the previous few seasons, you were unexpectedly injured on the field, and it was rumored that the injury almost forced you to retire, which was a great pity for everyone.

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Fortunately, now you've proven yourself with your performance, telling us that true strength won't bow down to difficulties!

steps.speaker: Nike
steps.content: Yes... I've completely overcome the impact of the injury. I'm no longer... the helpless person lying in some hospital bed...
For a moment, there's a glaze over Nike's eyes, but when he grips the trophy in his hand, his expression instantly becomes firm, not wavering for a moment.

steps.speaker: Nike
steps.content: ...That's right! Now, the person standing on the podium is me. I am the champion!

steps.speaker: Nike
steps.content: In that difficult period, I never thought of giving up. I persisted in rehabilitation every day, finally overcoming my slump, and that's how I gained this victory!

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Your spirit is truly admirable, an your experience will definitely motivate many people!

Under the bright lights and fluttering ribbons, Nike shows a proud smile. He brushes off the momentary confusion in his mind and continues to immerse himself in this honor and glory that he will forever miss.
